patch.value:
External report: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1207

Existing findings and failed_because contracts from pm-larv4r are shipped and must be reused. This item owns the remaining boolean/strictness authority boundary, not the already completed self-indexing work.
GH-1207: Make advisory health checks and strict verdict authority explicit

GitHub #1207 reports top-level ok true while the storage check has ok false with warn status, and strict CLI exit 2. The closed self-indexing finding work supplies severity and failed_because but does not make the per-check boolean or strict process verdict authoritative. Define compatible SDK and CLI semantics so agents can reliably branch without inferring precedence.

Reproduce advisory storage and strict invocation verdicts in an isolated tracker; Publish one authoritative invocation verdict with adjacent deciding reasons; Per-check booleans and severity have documented compatible semantics; SDK, CLI, summary and full projections agree for identical strictness; Preserve existing advisory versus blocking policy
